name: Sofia Vargas
bio:
Sofia Vargas is a highly experienced aerodynamicist who has dedicated her life to the pursuit of speed. Born and raised in Bogotá, Colombia, she developed a fascination with flight and engineering at a young age. This passion led her to pursue a degree in aerospace engineering, followed by a master's in computational fluid dynamics. Her career began with a small aerospace firm, but her ambition soon drew her to the world of motorsport.

Sofia's approach to aerodynamics is both meticulous and innovative. She believes in a data-driven methodology, rigorously analyzing simulations and wind tunnel results to optimize performance. However, she also encourages creative thinking and experimentation, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. She is known for her ability to identify subtle aerodynamic advantages that can make a significant difference on the track. Now at Walkinshaw Andretti United, she hopes to push the team to the front of the grid.

What sets Sofia apart is her unwavering focus and her ability to inspire her team. She is a natural leader, capable of motivating engineers and fostering a collaborative environment. Her calm demeanor under pressure and her dedication to excellence make her an invaluable asset to any racing organization.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical bun during wind tunnel sessions but otherwise worn loose with soft waves.
physical.description: Sofia is a woman of medium height with a confident, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and ideas.
Insists on using specific Colombian coffee beans in the aero department's coffee machine.
Has a collection of miniature wind tunnel models on her desk, each representing a different stage of her career.
